leads: SHAYMIN lives in the grass on|ROUTE 102, west of OLDALE.|You can look for it right away.
Take CUT into PETALBURG WOODS.|CELEBI lives in the third area.
VIRIZION lives in the second|area of PETALBURG WOODS.|Check its sign for the full roster.
MELOETTA answers songs in|DEWFORD MEADOW. Bring a partner|with SING to the warden there.
COSMOG drifts through the grass|in DEWFORD MEADOW. You can find|it on your first visit.
DEVON's dream researcher on 2F|has a MAGEARNA prototype.|Catch DIANCIE before visiting him.
DEVON's dream researcher on 2F|also has an ARCEUS reward.|Resolve the weather crisis and|earn all eight badges to claim it.
THUNDURUS can appear in the|grass on ROUTE 110. First help|the WEATHER INSTITUTE researchers.
MEWTWO waits on ALTERING CAVE B1F.|Reach the cave by SURFING|along ROUTE 103.
For ZERAORA, finish WATTSON's|generator job and report back.|Then search NEW MAUVILLE inside.
REGIELEKI also lives inside|NEW MAUVILLE. Catch REGISTEEL|and finish WATTSON's generator job.
ZEKROM can appear inside|NEW MAUVILLE after WATTSON's job.|Remember to report back to him.
The original ZAPDOS waits inside|NEW MAUVILLE. Approach it there|when you are ready.
GENESECT is a prize at the|MAUVILLE GAME CORNER.|Ask at the POKéMON prize counter.
The GAME CORNER's POKéMON prize|counter also offers POIPOLE.
For PHIONE, leave MANAPHY and|DITTO at ROUTE 117's DAY CARE.|Hatch the Egg they produce.
ENAMORUS lives in VERDANTURF|MEADOW's grass. Check the area|sign for the other residents.
Bring CASTFORM to the archaeologist|at ROUTE 111's elevated ruins.|Helping his weather survey lets|you find LANDORUS there.
VOLCANION lives on MAGMA|HIDEOUT 4F. First confront MAXIE|deep inside the hideout.
REGIDRAGO lives in METEOR FALLS'|upper 1F room. Catch REGIROCK|before you go looking for it.
For CRESSELIA, catch DARKRAI and|help the elders at MT. PYRE.|Then search METEOR FALLS'|second B1F room.
TORNADUS can appear in ROUTE 119's|grass after you rescue the|WEATHER INSTITUTE researchers.
RESHIRAM lives on SCORCHED SLAB|B2F, off ROUTE 120. It is an|ordinary rare wild resident.
For DARKRAI, befriend a member|of MUSHARNA's family and help|the elders at MT. PYRE.|Then visit the summit shrine.
YVELTAL can appear in the outside|grass at MT. PYRE. First help|the elders and receive their ORB.
PECHARUNT waits on MT. PYRE's|sixth floor. Catch OKIDOGI,|MUNKIDORI and FEZANDIPITI,|then inspect the shrine.
The original ARTICUNO waits in|SHOAL CAVE's low-tide ice room.
KYUREM can appear in SHOAL CAVE's|low-tide ice room. Catch either|RESHIRAM or ZEKROM first.
TERAPAGOS lives on CAVE OF ORIGIN|B1F. Resolve the SOOTOPOLIS|weather crisis before searching.
After the weather crisis, search|while SURFING on ROUTE 126.|TAPU FINI can appear there.
KELDEO can appear while SURFING|on ROUTE 127 once the weather|crisis is resolved.
Take REGIROCK, REGICE and|REGISTEEL together to the statue|inside the SEALED CHAMBER.|That is where REGIGIGAS waits.
VICTINI lives on VICTORY ROAD 1F.|Check the area signs as you climb|toward the POKéMON LEAGUE.
TERRAKION lives on VICTORY ROAD|B1F. You can encounter it in|the cave like other wild POKéMON.
The CHAMPIONS CIRCUIT at the|BATTLE TOWER awards CALYREX and|other legendaries at win milestones.|Ask its attendant about rewards.
ETERNATUS is the CIRCUIT mastery|reward. Win 40 battles in total|and claim its other legendary|rewards, then see the attendant.
